name: SAP CAP Developer (Cloud Application Programming Model)
title: SAP CAP Developer (Cloud Application Programming Model)
description: Enterprise backend development with SAP Cloud Application Programming Model (CAP). Core Data Services (CDS) modeling, custom event handlers (before/on/after), persistence on SQLite & HANA Cloud, external service integration via SAP Cloud SDK, security annotations, and Fiori frontends.

levels.title: Level 0 — CAP Architecture, CLI & CDS Modeling
levels.description: CAP philosophy (convention over configuration), CDS language, entities, types, associations, and compositions.

subjects.title: CDS Data Modeling & Service Definitions
subjects.description: Core subject domain covering CDS Data Modeling & Service Definitions.

topics.title: Core Data Services (CDS) & Entity Relations
topics.description: Define domain models, managed aspects (cuid, managed), associations, and compositions in schema.cds.
learningObjectives: Understand internal architecture and core mechanics of Core Data Services (CDS) & Entity Relations
Implement production-grade components using industry best practices for Core Data Services (CDS) & Entity Relations
Diagnose runtime errors, misconfigurations, and edge cases in Core Data Services (CDS) & Entity Relations
Explain design trade-offs and answer senior technical interview questions on Core Data Services (CDS) & Entity Relations

learningItems.title: CAP Architecture: Separation of Domain Data Model, Service Definitions, and Custom Logic
@sap/cds-dk CLI Setup & Project Scaffolding (cds init, cds watch)
Defining Entities, Custom Types, Enums & Built-in Types in schema.cds
Built-in Aspects: cuid (UUID keys), managed (createdAt, createdBy, modifiedAt), temporal
Service Definitions in srv/cat-service.cds & OData Service Expositions

practice.title: Hands-on Lab: Core Data Services (CDS) & Entity Relations
practice.description: Implement, test, and validate core patterns of Core Data Services (CDS) & Entity Relations in a realistic workspace environment.

practice.title: Independent Challenge: Core Data Services (CDS) & Entity Relations
practice.description: Build end-to-end functionality for Core Data Services (CDS) & Entity Relations from scratch and verify production error handling.

debugging.title: Diagnose & Resolve Production Issue in Core Data Services (CDS) & Entity Relations
debugging.description: Troubleshoot a scenario where Core Data Services (CDS) & Entity Relations throws unexpected exceptions or fails under high load / invalid payload.
